notes: Runners substitute $LIBRARY_NAME/$LIBRARY_VERSION with their own identity and must add their platform context blocks (app/device/os/network/screen/timezone/...) — compare after removing every context key not present in `expected` except library/consent/identities, and never compare the ignoreContextKeys.
timestamp === sentAt === event CREATION time (isoNow once per payload), ISO-8601 UTC with exactly 3 fractional digits; messageId = uuid v4 lowercase.
Top-level key order: messageId, type, anonymousId, context, timestamp, sentAt, [userId], then per-type fields. context.identities and a missing context.consent are attached at ENQUEUE time.
page/* cases are JS-only (platforms tag); mobile has screen().

cases.description: properties pass through verbatim incl. nested objects, arrays, numbers, booleans and null
track('') produces nothing (silent return, no callback)
JS has one number type: 1.0 serialises as 1
userId is appended AFTER sentAt in the base payload
previousId defaults to the current anonymousId
integration needs BOTH name and version or it is dropped
a persisted userId from a previous session rides on every event
